messages.content: Which planet do humans live on?

message.content: Humans live on **Earth**. While other planets have been studied, Earth is the only one that has been habitable for life as we know it for millions of years. Other planets like Venus (the hottest) and Mars (the red planet) have not been confirmed as habitable.
